omens.desc: A comet stirs a people: local asabiya rises

omens.name: Discord
omens.desc: Rival claimants split a realm: its cohesion falls

omens.name: Bounty
omens.desc: A century of good harvests: the land feeds more people

omens.name: Drought
omens.desc: Six decades of failed rains: hunger and flight

omens.name: Spark
omens.desc: A brilliant mind appears: the realm learns new techniques

omens.name: Prophet
omens.desc: A prophet begins to preach a new faith here

omens.name: Pestilence
omens.desc: A new disease breaks out here

omens.name: Cataclysm
omens.desc: Unleash the catastrophe of the age here

cataclysms.title: The Great Deluge
cataclysms.why: Rivers burst and the sea breaks in; fields, stores and villages are swept away.

cataclysms.title: The Eruption of {place}
cataclysms.why: Ash buries the land for hundreds of kilometres and the sky darkens across the world.

cataclysms.title: The Great Unravelling
cataclysms.text: raiders, drought and famine break the palaces around {place}
cataclysms.why: Trade collapses and writing is forgotten across a whole region.

cataclysms.title: The Year Without Summer
cataclysms.text: the sun dims and harvests fail across the world
cataclysms.why: A distant eruption veils the sky; famine and disorder follow.

cataclysms.title: The Great Earthquake of {place}
cataclysms.why: Cities fall and a great wave sweeps the coast.

cataclysms.title: The Long Winter
cataclysms.text: a long cold settles on the world
cataclysms.why: Seventy years of short summers bring famine, revolts and wandering peoples.

cataclysms.title: The Starfall
cataclysms.text: a rock from the sky strikes near {place}
cataclysms.why: Fire, then years of dark skies across the whole world.
